Consider the picture shown above. Which of the following is a unit vector that is parallel to $p?$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251721/assets/4d4d7faa0c0611c8ef891cda5fef3b75a61aa97e0879fac525f58f4ce263c937.png)

In $△AHB$, we have $∠AHB={90}^{∘}$, $AH=2$ and $BH=5.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =\sqrt{A{H}^{2}+B{H}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{5}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{4+25} \\  & =\sqrt{29}.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, the magnitude of $p$ is $\sqrt{29}.$ Consequently, the unit vector is

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =\frac{1}{|\,p\,|}\cdot p \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{29}}p.\end{aligned}
$$
